children: Syno Invest AS, a related party to Øyvind Torpp, EVP & Investment Executive, has on 22 September 2026 bought 10,000 shares in Orkla ASA at a price of NOK 92.6898 per share. The shares were acquired on the Oslo Stock Exchange. Following this transaction, Torpp and related parties own 160,000 shares in Orkla.
This information is subject to disclosure requirements set out in the Market Abuse Regulation EU 596/2014 Article 19 and the Norwegian Securities Trading Act Section 5-12.

title: Orkla ASA: Mandatory notification of trade – primary insiders
